svg.id: 04 · ONB-102 – Prompt ideas in the empty prompt box

text.tspan: Turn an idea into a playable game. Describe it in plain words and Spark builds the first
version in Unity with you — so, what do you want to make?

g.text: Try “a cozy forest game where you collect fireflies before nightfall”

text.id: Collect fireflies before nightfall in a storybook forest.
Reroute power to escape a drifting station.
Zip around town on a scooter and beat the clock.
